items.headline: Nice Touch V2: an AI edit assistant for professional editors
items.excerpt: Nice Touch shipped V2, a full rebuild of its AI workflow/edit assistant that runs inside Adobe Premiere Pro and DaVinci Resolve. The company says the redesign came out of more than 300 conversations with editors, producers, post supervisors and studio owners.

items.headline: Beeble introduces SwitchX 2.0 with native 4K, longer shots and more
items.excerpt: Beeble's SwitchX 2.0 lets filmmakers and VFX artists change lighting, backgrounds and props in existing footage, now at native 4K, 10-bit, and up to 20-second clips at 24fps. The update also improves camera tracking, motion fidelity and lip sync.

items.headline: Colorfront and Qumulo at IBC2026: metadata does not have to die in transit
items.excerpt: Colorfront and Qumulo showed a joint IBC2026 workflow that writes on-set information — camera settings, colour decisions, framing — directly into files so it survives every handoff and stays searchable. Colorfront's Transkoder and On-Set Dailies 2026 add AI-derived text detection and automated QC findings.

items.headline: Acon Acoustica 8 Provides AI-Assisted Audio Workflow Tools
items.excerpt: Acon Digital released Acoustica 8, adding AI-assisted tools to its audio editing, restoration and mastering suite. The company frames the release as a direct response to technical problems raised by working audio post professionals.

items.headline: Avid Media Composer 2026.8 Offers Agentic Workflows and More
items.excerpt: Media Composer 2026.8 adds 'Ready to Edit' agentic content prep plus Google Gemini integration inside the editing interface, alongside deeper Avid Content Core ties. Avid positions the automation as handling assembly chores while editorial judgement stays with the editor.

items.headline: Premiere's new AI tools, explained by Adobe
items.excerpt: In an IBC interview, Adobe walks through Premiere's new AI-assisted features — timeline video generation, sound effect creation and audio cleanup — and argues they target drudgery, not judgement. Adobe's line: 'all the creative decisions remain with the editor.'

items.headline: IBC2026: 10 top things to see
items.excerpt: RedShark's IBC2026 floor list puts Adobe's Generative Media Tool and Eddie AI's review/comment export alongside cameras, lighting and QScan automated QC. The through-line: the AI worth seeing 'removes annoying bits of the process' rather than replacing craft.

items.headline: Pitch Black Rolls Out REVIZE Machine Learning Across Its Global Studios
items.excerpt: The face- and body-replacement toolset Rising Sun Pictures began building in 2018 — used on 30+ films including 'Sinners' and 'Mickey 17' — is now deployed at FOLKS, El Ranchito and Square One. Longtime RSP leader Troy Tobin runs the program.

items.headline: Maxon to Preview Fall Cinema 4D, ZBrush and Redshift Updates at IBC2026
items.excerpt: Maxon's October ecosystem release previews new 3D world-building in Cinema 4D, a desktop-and-iPad ZBrush sculpting workflow, procedural fur, and AI-powered relighting in Redshift. Booth visitors got the early look September 11-14.

items.headline: Nikola Todorovic on the latest developments in Autodesk's Flow Studio
items.excerpt: Wonder Dynamics co-founder Nikola Todorovic explains how Flow Studio's new 3D Editor and Canvas work, and where generative tooling sits in a shot-based VFX pipeline. The interview details the hand-off between AI-assisted steps and artist control.

items.headline: The director of 'HOPE' breaks down those chase scenes, and working on mocap with Alicia Vikander and Michael Fassbender
items.excerpt: The director of 'HOPE' walks through the film's chase sequences and the performance-capture sessions with Alicia Vikander and Michael Fassbender. The piece also covers how the creatures were designed around captured performance.

items.headline: Adobe Unveils New Generative Media Tool in Premiere, Plus More AI-Powered Updates
items.excerpt: Adobe's IBC 2026 release puts a Generative Media Tool in the Premiere timeline: draw a range on a track, describe what you need, and generate video or sound effects without leaving the app. Firefly and partner models including Google Veo sit behind it, and an After Effects AI Assistant is also coming.

items.headline: Kling AI's TIFF Market Panel Illuminates Tech Challenges and Human-Led Solutions in AI Filmmaking: 'The Script Is Still the Blueprint'
items.excerpt: At Kling AI's TIFF 'The Market' panel on consistent, cinematic AI video, filmmakers argued the script still governs the work regardless of model capability. The session laid out where character consistency and shot control still break down in practice.

items.headline: Amazon's Prime Video Is Using AI to Lip-Sync Actors' Mouths in Dubbed Titles, Starting With German Series 'Maxton Hall'
items.excerpt: Prime Video is applying AI visual dubbing to alter actors' mouth movements so English dubs match the dialogue, beginning with the German series 'Maxton Hall.' It moves lip-sync dubbing from beta demos into a streamer's shipping localization pipeline.

items.headline: Former Telepool Chief Yoko Higuchi-Zitzmann, Filmmaker Mark Wachholz Launch AI Production Company Dreamkite Studios
items.excerpt: Munich- and Berlin-based Dreamkite Studios launches as an AI-native film studio combining generative tools with conventional production, employing professional directors and actors. The remit covers both AI-first and hybrid projects.

items.headline: Venice Jury President Maggie Gyllenhaal on Her Short 'Flesh Impact,' Casting Ellen Burstyn, and AI
items.excerpt: Maggie Gyllenhaal discusses her Venice short 'Flesh Impact' with Ellen Burstyn — and why the AI experiment she attempted on it failed. A working director's account of where generative tools broke against the material.

items.headline: New CG software you may have missed: 7 September 2026
items.excerpt: CG Channel's fortnightly roundup includes AI Studio 1.1, now available standalone and supporting Seedance 2.5 for generative image and video work, plus RE:Vision Effects' new VFR2CFR frame-rate conversion utility. Other entries cover Unity, Smooth Weights 2, RealityScan Mobile and the 3DGS Render Blender add-on.

items.headline: OpenAI's New Image Model Is Brilliant... Until You Look Closer
items.excerpt: Curious Refuge reviews GPT Image 2.5 against the leading AI image models, testing where it holds up for film work and where it visibly fails. The verdict is a working filmmaker's read on concept and keyframe generation quality.

items.headline: We Found a Weird Seedance Character Hack
items.excerpt: Curious Refuge walks through a viral face-grid trick for generating AI video shots featuring real people with consistent likeness in Seedance. It's a concrete technique for holding a character across shots.
